metadata.title: Claude, Customer Research.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: what does the customer-research skill do, and how? Lands the carry-out that a skill is a written set of steps, not a new capability, and this one turns a customer question into the same multi-source, attributed findings every time.
metadata.anchor: the SKILL.md file itself — named B01, traced B02, edged B03
metadata.beat_count_note: source is 7 beats (B00/B01/B02/B03/BVDT/BHTF/BOUT); kept beat count, B00->writer, BVDT->BCRY

beats.narration_text: Claude doesn't already know your customer — it looks up sources you give it and attributes what it finds. How does that actually work? Let's open the customer-research skill and look.

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'Claude knows my customer. / How does that work?', hesitates on 'knows', corrects to 'checks sources for'

props.text:
Claude knows my customer.
How does that work?

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('knows' -> 'checks sources for') is visible on a late frame. NOTE: lead_silence_s is not actually consumed by generate_audio_kokoro.py/remotion_scenes.py/compile.py (known toolkit gap, logged on the call-summary sibling build) — the real clock is narration-only audio duration, so on-screen text must be short enough to complete within that.

beats.narration_text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is called customer-research. Inside is one file — SKILL.md — written in plain language: multi-source research on a customer question, with source attribution. Claude reads that file, then acts.

production_viz.label: A SKILL IS A FOLDER
production_viz.caption: one file, written in plain language

beats.narration_text: The instructions are steps, and Claude runs them in order: read the SKILL.md, execute each step as written, then return the output. One pass, no branching unless a step says so.

production_viz.label: READ, EXECUTE, RETURN
production_viz.caption: linear — no branching unless a step says so

beats.narration_text: Because the steps are fixed, the same customer question gets the same treatment every run — pull sources, attribute them, hand back the findings. Ask it to skip the sources and just guess, and there's no instruction for that; customer-research only does what its steps describe.
A skill isn't a new power Claude has — it's a written set of steps. customer-research turns your question into the same multi-source, attributed findings, every single time.

props.quote: A skill isn't a new power Claude has — it's a written set of steps. customer-research turns your question into the same multi-source, attributed findings, every single time.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: Read the customer-research skill and walk me through what you're about to do before you do it. Then use it on this: paste the customer's question here — research it across the sources I've given you, and attribute what you find. That first line matters — watching Claude explain the plan before it runs shows you exactly which step in the skill is doing the work.

props.command: Read the customer-research skill and walk me through what you're about to do before you do it. Then use it on this: [paste the customer's question here] — research it across the sources I've given you, and attribute what you find.

beats.narration_text: Claude, Customer Research. Liam, in for Bear.
